doctrine: Human-pinned official station IDs. An override wins over name matching. Pin only a station you would defend by the water's published name — never a nearby substitute. Example: Barnegat Bay → USGS 01408167 (the estuary site that publishes under Barnegat Bay). Do not pin Lake Washington to 12150400 — that site is the Snoqualmie River at Duvall.
